title: Worm Rate
description: breaking dirt has a chance of giving a worm!
body:
Wormrate enables you to have worms be given upon dirt breaking!
useful for adding whimsyness to your minecraft server! good for bentonquest, achievements, etc.
![I recieved a worm!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/326edfe6f6b88ebf51574473e2bda6b44b1c9001.png)
Commands:
```
    /wormrate list
    /wormrate get <block>
    /wormrate set <block> <percent>
    /wormrate reset <block>
    /wormrate addblock <block <percent>
    /wormrate removeblock <block>
    /wormrate tilling <on|off|status>
```
Config
```
  - DIRT
  - PODZOL
  - COARSE_DIRT
  - GRASS_BLOCK
  - MYCELIUM
  - FARMLAND
  - ROOTED_DIRT

sources:
  dirt-tilling-enabled: true

drop-rates:
  PODZOL: 0.002
  COARSE_DIRT: 0.002
  GRASS_BLOCK: 0.01
  MYCELIUM: 0.002
  FARMLAND: 0.002
  ROOTED_DIRT: 0.002
  DIRT: 0.002
```
